abort.no_devices_found: No Thunderboard found nearby. Make sure the board is powered over USB and advertising.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

user.description: Choose a device to set up

data_description.scan_interval: How often the values are read from the board.
data_description.keep_device_connected: Required for the button presses and the LEDs, the board turns its LEDs off when the connection closes.
data_description.scan_timeout: How long to try connecting to the board, all attempts included.
data_description.max_connection_attempts: Number of attempts to connect to the board.
data_description.add_ble_callback: Read the board as soon as it advertises again, for example after it restarted.
data_description.event_debounce_time: Limits how often the advertisements of the board trigger a refresh.
